edus.text: Mr. Speaker, I beg to propose a bill called An Act to use a sum of money from the Consolidated Fund for additional expenses for the service of 2022 - this is last year.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]

edus.text: Already completed, not this year
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]

edus.text: — to allocate that sum of money for specific purposes for that year be read a second time now.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, the additional allocation of the first operating expenses of 2022 is presented in accordance with Article 101 of the Federal Constitution, which is to obtain approval for expenses
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]

edus.text: that are not allocated or not fully allocated in the 2022 Budget which has been approved earlier by this honorable House.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]

edus.text: The first additional operating expenses estimate of 2022 presented amounts to RM60,174.9 million or RM60.1749 billion to finance supply expenses.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]

edus.text: Additional estimates of supply expenses requested to be approved under Clause 2 of the bill presented are as much as RM60,174.9 million which can be summarized as follows -
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]

edus.text: A total of RM1,663.5 million or RM1.6635 billion is for the transfer of surplus from the Consolidated Revenue Account 2022 to the Development Fund.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]

edus.text: This transfer is charged part of the expenditure under the meaning of B.12 allocation to the Statutory Fund.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]

edus.text: For the information of Honorable Members, this transfer is in accordance with the provisions under subsection 10(1) of the Financial Procedures Act 1957 [Act 61] and not a new expenditure but is part of the financial need to cover development expenses for 2022 amounting to RM71,574.0 million or RM71.574 billion whose remaining is financed through loans.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]

edus.text: A total of RM676.9 million is to recoup the amount that has been prioritized from the Overseas Fund to cover the unforeseen expenses of 2022 as contained in the statement presented as Order Paper 23 of 2023.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]

edus.text: A total of RM57,834.5 million is an additional allocation directly to the ministry, departments that have been given permission to spend more than the allocation to finance matters committed in 2022.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, the ministries involved in this Additional Expenditure Estimate are as follows:
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]

edus.text: ( i ) Ministry of Finance amounting to RM56,209.5 million or RM56.2095 billion;
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]

edus.text: ( ii ) Ministry of Domestic Trade and Cost of Living amounting to RM2,058.1 million or RM2.0581 billion;
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]

edus.text: ( iii ) Ministry of Education amounting to RM803.6 million;
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]

edus.text: ( iv ) Ministry of Health amounting to RM676.5 million;
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]

edus.text: ( v ) Ministry of Defense amounting to RM303.7 million;
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]

edus.text: ( vi ) Election Commission, Prime Minister's Department amounting to RM84.8 million;
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]

edus.text: ( vii ) Ministry of Agriculture and Food Guarantee amounting to RM24.5 million;
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]

edus.text: ( viii ) Ministry of National Unity amounting to RM14.1 million;
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]

edus.text: That's the list of nine ministries.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, the details and further explanations regarding the additional allocation for the First Supplementary Managing Expenditure Estimate 2022 are as in the additional budget statement presented as Order Paper 21 of 2023 and the Treasury Memorandum presented as Order Paper 21A of 2023.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]

edus.text: Everything is on the table of Honorable Members.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]

edus.text: Now allow me to submit the First Supplementary Development Expenditure Estimate 2022.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]

edus.text: The First Supplementary Development Expenditure Estimate 2022 amounts to RM6,350.2 million.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]

edus.text: Of that amount as much as RM284.0 million is an advance that has been withdrawn from unforeseen savings.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]

edus.text: Additional estimates are needed to finance development projects for the following purposes:
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]

edus.text: ( i ) amounting to RM6,066.2 million for the Ministry of Finance;
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]

edus.text: ( ii ) amounting to RM200 million for the Ministry of Public Works;
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]

edus.text: ( iii ) amounting to RM84 million for the Ministry of National Unity.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]

edus.text: Apart from that, this additional estimate also contains an application for a sign or token allocation of RM220 for several ministries.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]

edus.text: The allocation of these signs or tokens is to create new details to allow the transfer of allocations to be made between the details.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]

edus.text: Further explanations and explanations about the First Supplementary Development Expenditure Estimate 2022 are as stated in the First Supplementary Development Expenditure Estimate Statement 2022 presented as Order Paper 22 of 2023
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]

edus.text: and the Treasury Memorandum presented as Order Paper 22(A) of 2023 which is on the table of Honorable Members.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, I would like to inform here that the additional expenditure estimate requested amounts to RM60,174.9 million for supply expenses and RM6,350.2 million for development expenses is part of the actual total expenditure for 2022
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]

edus.text: and it does not affect the fiscal deficit that has been set at a level of 5.6 percent.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]

edus.text: I will submit a Motion on the First Supplementary Development Expenditure Estimate 2022 after this speech.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]

edus.text: I beg to propose.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]

edus.text: Anyone support?
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, I beg to support.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kerja Raya [Dato’ Sri Haji Abdul Rahman bin Mohamad]

edus.text: Assalamualaikum warahmatullahi wabarakatuh and greetings.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: Let's start the Minister's Question Time and invite the Honorable Tuan Sim Tze Tzin, Bayan Baru.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: Thank you Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]

edus.text: Good morning to the teachers and also the headmasters here, in this House.
edus.speaker: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]

edus.text: [ Applause ]
edus.speaker: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]

edus.text: I would like to represent the teachers out there to bring their hearts to the teachers' ministers, teachers' ministers.
edus.speaker: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]

edus.text: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin asked the Minister of Education to state whether the Ministry of Education will conduct a technical audit on the IDentity Management System ( idMe ), the Ministry of Education Integrated System ( MOEIS ) which often experiences technical disruptions that make it difficult for the duties of tens of thousands of teachers.
edus.speaker: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]

edus.text: State the development expenses of this system and what action will be taken by the Ministry of Education against failed vendor companies?
edus.speaker: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]

edus.text: Bismillahi Rahmani Rahim.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: Assalamualaikum warahmatullahi wabarakatuh and good morning.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: Thank you my friend Yang Berhormat Bayan Baru.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: For your information, the Malaysian Ministry of Education realizes that there is a access disruption to the Identity Management System ( idMe ) and the MoE Integrated System ( MOEIS ).
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: The MoE detected the disruption starting on 19 January 2023 due to technical issues and system use issues.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: The issue was resolved on 11 February 2023.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: The system's performance continues to be monitored to ensure that it is always operating well to minimize access disruptions.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: The MoE has identified the root of the problem to the entire system taking into account the overall system management as well as competency personnel to further strengthen the implementation of the system.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: As of 16 March 2023 Your Honor, a total of 89 percent of schools across the country have finished including data in the Integrated Assessment Management System under MOEIS through idMe.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: While the rest have the option to include data either through this management system or offline.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: Despite being given the option,
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: there are three states that use the Integrated Assessment Management System ( SPPB ) 100 percent, namely the states of Kelantan, Sarawak and the Federal Territory of Labuan.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: While the state of Perlis reached 99 percent of the filling into the system.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: I would like to thank all the teachers who were patient when this system was in a lawsuit,
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: even giving full cooperation when the MoE did a visit
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: and was ready with the hybrid system,
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: while we tried to improve the efficiency of this system.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: For your information, online classroom assessment involves several modules that are developed separately.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: The modules are idME, MOEIS Institutional Modul, MOEIS Student Modul and SPPB.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: MOEIS is developed internally
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: while idMe and SPPB are developed in production to two different companies.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: These two systems are obtained in a quote and open tender in line with the Government Procurement Circular based on the ceiling price that has been set in the tender.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: For your information, the MoE will not compromise on any violation of the terms and conditions that have been set for the company that implements this system.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: For your information, the MoE is ready and open for any in-house technical inquiry and audit
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: if there are allegations regarding the violation of the procedure for the implementation of this system.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: That's it, thank you Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: Thank you head teacher.
edus.speaker: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]

edus.text: Earlier I asked the Honorable Minister to answer the cost of developing this project.
edus.speaker: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]

edus.text: That's the first question.
edus.speaker: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]

edus.text: It's clear that this system failed and this is not new.
edus.speaker: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]

edus.text: There used to be many complaints from teachers out there.
edus.speaker: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]

edus.text: It should be focused on educating our children
edus.speaker: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]

edus.text: but had to key in data until 4am.
edus.speaker: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]

edus.text: I think this is an injustice
edus.speaker: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]

edus.text: and also torture to our teachers.
edus.speaker: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]

edus.text: So, I hope the ministry is firm in this regard.
edus.speaker: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]

edus.text: I hope and request that the Honorable Minister call the National Audit Department, look into whether there is any abuse of power or failures?
edus.speaker: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]

edus.text: Make sure that this new system is improved so
edus.speaker: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]

edus.text: that our teachers can focus on learning our children.
edus.speaker: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]

edus.text: Thank you, Your Honor.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: I record my gratitude for your concern for the issue
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: and we do take notice of those matters.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: Therefore, I mentioned earlier, Your Honor, among the quick actions we are making include providing a hybrid system
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: and also visiting the assistance we offer to these teachers to help in their process fill in the information.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: Your Honor, I would also like to inform you that we will work with the Administrative Modernization and Management Planning Unit ( MAMPU ) for the implementation of technical audits in this system.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: The result of this audit is to improve the existing system in the planning of the upcoming MoE system.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: We expect this audit, Your Honor, to be carried out in the second quarter of 2023.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: As I mentioned earlier, the MoE does not compromise with any or any relaxation of terms or any failure in the procedures that have been set in the company that implements this system.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: Thank you, Your Honor.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: Honorable Minister, the cost of development.
edus.speaker: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]

edus.text: Your Honor, the cost for the idMe procurement contract value is as much as RM454,000
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: while the SPPB is as much as RM1.05 million.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: Please, Honorable Pasir Salak.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: Okay.
edus.speaker: Tuan Jamaludin bin Yahya [Pasir Salak]

edus.text: Thank you Mr. Speaker, Honorable Minister, my question is,
edus.speaker: Tuan Jamaludin bin Yahya [Pasir Salak]

edus.text: does the Ministry of Education want to stop this idMe?
edus.speaker: Tuan Jamaludin bin Yahya [Pasir Salak]

edus.text: This is because what happens is a small survey that is used, the data to be included is very large.
edus.speaker: Tuan Jamaludin bin Yahya [Pasir Salak]

edus.text: So, when we do that, what happens, teachers want to include data.
edus.speaker: Tuan Jamaludin bin Yahya [Pasir Salak]

edus.text: Teachers put data in two ways.
edus.speaker: Tuan Jamaludin bin Yahya [Pasir Salak]

edus.text: First, manually.
edus.speaker: Tuan Jamaludin bin Yahya [Pasir Salak]

edus.text: Second, through this idMe,
edus.speaker: Tuan Jamaludin bin Yahya [Pasir Salak]

edus.text: so two things that teachers have to do
edus.speaker: Tuan Jamaludin bin Yahya [Pasir Salak]

edus.text: while we're trying to reduce the burden of these teachers.
edus.speaker: Tuan Jamaludin bin Yahya [Pasir Salak]

edus.text: What is the comment of the Honorable Minister?
edus.speaker: Tuan Jamaludin bin Yahya [Pasir Salak]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Tuan Jamaludin bin Yahya [Pasir Salak]

edus.text: Please, Honorable Minister.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: Thank you, Honorable Pasir Salak.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: I appreciate and record thank you for that view.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: Yes, we take into account everything related to the burdens of this teacher's duties.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: In close regard to this system, I remember it is also important for me to record that we will be more careful
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: and give enough time to all parties involved in the ministry to review, improve and most importantly also especially in technical system testing activities as well as user change management activities including a pilot implementation approach in an effort
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: to ensure the smooth use of all those systems.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: Currently, Your Honor, we do not have any stance to abolish or stop this system
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: but we will improve
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: because we see that this system still has good interests towards reducing the burden of teachers as well.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: At the same time, we are committed to improving this system.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: Thank you, Your Honor.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: Thank you, Honorable Minister.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: Next, I invite Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali, Honorable Kapar.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: Bismillahi Rahmani Rahim.
edus.speaker: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar]

edus.text: Thank you, Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar]

edus.text: One of the questions or complaints I have received since becoming a Member of Parliament is about this question.
edus.speaker: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar]

edus.text: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali asked the Minister of Health to state whether the ministry has made a decision to prohibit patients from using health clinic services closer to their homes after the re-delimitation of the constituency.
edus.speaker: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar]

edus.text: Thank you Honorable Kapar.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: Thank you Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, the ministry is very committed to providing health services to all citizens.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: All health personnel at triages or registration counters are reminded not to reject any presence of any customer to seek treatment at a health clinic to meet the No Wrong Door Policy approach that has been implemented through personalized care or family doctor concept to ensure continuous health care
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: and can not be used as an excuse to reject customers who come from outside the health clinic cooperative area.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: For example, patients who receive treatment at health clinics in the Kapar Parliamentary area can seek treatment at nearby health clinics, for example in the Bukit Raja Parliamentary area
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: if the health clinic is close to the patient's residence for the comfort and convenience of the patient.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: Good, Honorable Kapar.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: Thank you Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar]

edus.text: Thank you Honorable Minister.
edus.speaker: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar]

edus.text: So, indeed that is the code of ethics for health.
edus.speaker: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar]

edus.text: I want to give a setting– That is ideal.
edus.speaker: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar]

edus.text: I want to mention the practical, where we get this complaint.
edus.speaker: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar]

edus.text: When the third bridge of Klang was built by the Selangor State Government worth RM300 million,
edus.speaker: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar]

edus.text: the Sungai Bertek Mother and Child Clinic which at that time was old needs to be demolished.
edus.speaker: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar]

edus.text: At that time I was the assemblyman of the Klang Strait asking the government to replace not only pregnant and children but a more complete, comprehensive health center.
edus.speaker: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar]

edus.text: When that has existed and when it is completed, and cooperational, I was asked by the clinic to tell the people of the Klang Strait, Sungai Udang, Kampung Delek, those that don't know that this one already exist,
edus.speaker: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar]

edus.text: it is already operating, they can go there, no need to go to Pandamaran Health Clinic.
edus.speaker: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar]

edus.text: Unfortunately, unfortunately what is happening now Mr. Speaker, their house after the redelineation of GE14,
edus.speaker: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar]

edus.text: so the third bridge of Klang separates part of the former Klang Strait from the Klang Parliament.
edus.speaker: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar]

edus.text: These people are separated from the health clinic from their house like from here to the Member of Parliament's Building.
edus.speaker: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar]

edus.text: That's it, as close as that.
edus.speaker: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar]

edus.text: So, they say they can't accept it, they are told ...
edus.speaker: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar]

edus.text: What is the question?
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: ... go to Pandamaran Health Clinic.
edus.speaker: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar]

edus.text: Honorable Kapar, the question?
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: So, I want to ask– When was the one earlier, open door policy, right?
edus.speaker: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar]

edus.text: Please let me know, this should be the policy already.
edus.speaker: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar]

edus.text: So, why didn't that happen?
edus.speaker: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar]

edus.text: The question is Honorable Kapar, the question.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: And maybe is there a reason for not having enough staff?
edus.speaker: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar]

edus.text: Not enough medication?
edus.speaker: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar]

edus.text: Not enough what?
edus.speaker: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar]

edus.text: Okay, that's the question?
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: So, I ask for the action of the Honorable Minister.
edus.speaker: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar]

edus.text: Okay, thank you for the question.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: Good, thank you.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: Be patient, be patient.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: So, if it's true to happen ...
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: Very specific.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: Please.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: If it is true, Your Honor,
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: I request a complaint
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: and we will investigate this matter
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: and take appropriate action, God willing.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: Additional questions.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Muhammad Bakhtiar bin Wan Chik [Balik Pulau]

edus.text: [ Stands up ]
edus.speaker: Tuan Syed Ibrahim bin Syed Noh [Ledang]

edus.text: Please.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: Balik Pulau huh?
edus.speaker: Dato’ Muhammad Bakhtiar bin Wan Chik [Balik Pulau]

edus.text: Honorable Balik Pulau.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Dato’ Muhammad Bakhtiar bin Wan Chik [Balik Pulau]

edus.text: Thank you Mr. Speaker, very sure.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Muhammad Bakhtiar bin Wan Chik [Balik Pulau]

edus.text: Okay, I would like to ask the Honorable Minister of Health about the dress code that is now viral,
edus.speaker: Dato’ Muhammad Bakhtiar bin Wan Chik [Balik Pulau]

edus.text: which if they wear certain clothes they can not receive health services at clinics or hospitals.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Muhammad Bakhtiar bin Wan Chik [Balik Pulau]

edus.text: So, I would like to ask
edus.speaker: Dato’ Muhammad Bakhtiar bin Wan Chik [Balik Pulau]

edus.text: if the actual dress code or does the Ministry of Health accept anyone in emergency cases, regardless of how to dress and so on?
edus.speaker: Dato’ Muhammad Bakhtiar bin Wan Chik [Balik Pulau]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Muhammad Bakhtiar bin Wan Chik [Balik Pulau]

edus.text: Please, Honorable Minister.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: Thank you, Your Honor.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Dato’ Muhammad Bakhtiar bin Wan Chik [Balik Pulau]

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, I am aware of this matter and the things that have been viral in recent weeks.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: So, I want to tell you that in principle, every patient, Your Honor, must be given treatment priority regardless of race or dress code.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Dato’ Muhammad Bakhtiar bin Wan Chik [Balik Pulau]

edus.text: So, every medical practitioner including medical officers needs to take care of their ethics after we-
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Dato’ Muhammad Bakhtiar bin Wan Chik [Balik Pulau]

edus.text: We actually have a oath, we take a oath
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Dato’ Muhammad Bakhtiar bin Wan Chik [Balik Pulau]

edus.text: or are called a hypocrite oath that is pledged by especially doctors and medical practitioners including the willingness to help patients as best as possible.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Dato’ Muhammad Bakhtiar bin Wan Chik [Balik Pulau]

edus.text: So, I think maybe what happens is a communication problem
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Dato’ Muhammad Bakhtiar bin Wan Chik [Balik Pulau]

edus.text: and usually if we get a complaint, we take immediate action to ensure that the matter does not happen again.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Dato’ Muhammad Bakhtiar bin Wan Chik [Balik Pulau]

edus.text: Well thank you, I invite Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen, Honorable City of Kuching.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Kuching City] ask the Minister of Communications and Digital to state the ministry's intention to amend the provisions of section 2 of the Communications
edus.speaker: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: and Multimedia Act 1998 [ Act 588 ] to ensure it is not misused.
edus.speaker: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]
addressees: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: Thank you, Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: Thank you, Your Honor.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: The Ministry of Communications and Digital and the Malaysian Communications and Multimedia Commission ( SKMM ) are currently studying the amendment to the Communications and Multimedia Act 1998, where the comprehensive approach will take into account all existing legal provisions also ensure that any punishment is effective and there is no element of persecution.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: Among the proposed amendments submitted by SKMM
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: but have not yet been decided
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: and are still in discussion including the proposed amendment to section 233 of Act 588.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: The application of section 233 of Act 588 or the Communications and Multimedia Act 1998 is generally to deal with the misuse of network facilities, network services or application services, including social media platforms for the purpose of dissemination of content that is obscene, incest, false, threatening or obscene with the intention of hurting, mistreating, threatening or disturbing others.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: For the information of this honorable House, Act 588 has not yet been amended.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: Meaning, 25 years have passed
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: since this law was drafted, enacted and approved.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: We must know, 25 years ago,
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: now and 25 years to come, the state of technology, use, the existing platforms are also very different.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: So, when the ministry examines as a whole, we do not intend only to look at section 233.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: However, since a major change is happening,
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: if in the past we only used maybe 2G, 3G, now 5G and then how?
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: We must intend to see the objectives.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: Among the main objectives for the amendment is to encourage the development of the communication and multimedia industry for future needs ( fit for future ), improve the security aspect of the network following the increase in public consumption and dependence on digital services and there are several other things.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: However, because we are still in the discussion process,
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: my hope is to get feedback from either Members of Parliament, among NGOs, the public, legal experts for us to improve so
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: that there is no abuse of power or abuse of this section for political purposes.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: Please Dear City of Kuching.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: Thank you Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: Thank you Honorable Minister for the detailed answer.
edus.speaker: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]
addressees: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: I strongly agree that the act was 25 years ago
edus.speaker: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]
addressees: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: and we have to amend it to be in line with the development of time and for now's use.
edus.speaker: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]
addressees: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: So, we know that an act should be used for good.
edus.speaker: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]
addressees: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: I know to prevent pornographic materials and so on and most complaints are about the issue.
edus.speaker: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]
addressees: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: However, if it is not amended,
edus.speaker: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]
addressees: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: it is still open to abuse.
edus.speaker: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]
addressees: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: So my question is,
edus.speaker: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]
addressees: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: what steps can the ministry take to ensure what is supposed to be for good but not misuse?
edus.speaker: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]
addressees: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: Maybe for now, there is no prosecution in those obscene cases.
edus.speaker: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]
addressees: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: Can discuss with the Ministry of Home Affairs.
edus.speaker: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]
addressees: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: Good, thank you, Your Honor.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: There are several figures that I would like to state Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: Actually, what is quite interesting when we look into from January 2009 to January 31, 2023, the number of complaints received by SKMM based on the delivery element is 2,804.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: This is the complaint received.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: Of that number, as many as 1,625 or 57.9 percent are complaints about pornographic content.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: While the false information is as much as 564 or 20.1 percent and obscene content which amounts to 541 or 19.2 percent.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: Only based on the figures provided by this SKMM, when we state, more than 80 percent of the complaints received, not those investigated or those subject to penalties or punishments brought to court for example.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: More than 80 percent are not obscene complaints.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: In fact, we see that the majority are pornographic content.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: So from there we see, in general, this act is not misused.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: At least, not under the supervision of this ministry.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: It is quite interesting when we look into it, the complaints made throughout from 2009 to 2023, there are indeed patterns that are very interesting Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: For example, the highest number of complaints in 2010 was delivery complaints through SMS.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: If at that time in 2010,
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: there were 243 complaints but today,
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: I give an example as of 2022, only two complaints received through SMS format.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: At one point in 2009, it showed the highest number of complaints about blogs or websites which is 52 complaints but as of 2022, only eight.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: So we do see that there is a change.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: What is interesting is that the complaints received for WhatsApp show a trend that lasts from 2015 to 2022 around 40 to 50 complaints every year.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: So, we see the pattern of using the platforms as well, a matter that is being taken into account by the ministry.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: However, we will discuss with all parties including the Ministry of Home Affairs to make sure that this act and section in particular are not misused.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: Please, Honorable Pasir Puteh.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Datuk Dr. Nik Muhammad Zawawi bin Salleh [Pasir Puteh]

edus.text: Thank you Mr. Speaker and thank you Honorable Minister for giving an explanation.
edus.speaker: Datuk Dr. Nik Muhammad Zawawi bin Salleh [Pasir Puteh]
addressees: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: I examined the answer given, where the issue involving the amendment of the Communications and Digital Act is for us to ensure that our country is running properly.
edus.speaker: Datuk Dr. Nik Muhammad Zawawi bin Salleh [Pasir Puteh]
addressees: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: I want to talk about check and balance.
edus.speaker: Datuk Dr. Nik Muhammad Zawawi bin Salleh [Pasir Puteh]
addressees: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: We see in political issues, many of these leaders speak without facts and are exposed.
edus.speaker: Datuk Dr. Nik Muhammad Zawawi bin Salleh [Pasir Puteh]
addressees: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: It affects the election.
edus.speaker: Datuk Dr. Nik Muhammad Zawawi bin Salleh [Pasir Puteh]
addressees: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: So my question is,
edus.speaker: Datuk Dr. Nik Muhammad Zawawi bin Salleh [Pasir Puteh]
addressees: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: does the Malaysian Government today want to move forward by featuring political figures to have a dialogue openly and live broadcast in our country between the party presidents?
edus.speaker: Datuk Dr. Nik Muhammad Zawawi bin Salleh [Pasir Puteh]
addressees: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: Because we don't want time to be in the opposition, oil goes down, remove tolls.
edus.speaker: Datuk Dr. Nik Muhammad Zawawi bin Salleh [Pasir Puteh]
addressees: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: When ruling, there is nothing.
edus.speaker: Datuk Dr. Nik Muhammad Zawawi bin Salleh [Pasir Puteh]
addressees: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: So, we want the statement made, let there be a check and balance.
edus.speaker: Datuk Dr. Nik Muhammad Zawawi bin Salleh [Pasir Puteh]
addressees: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: Let the leaders speak freely.
edus.speaker: Datuk Dr. Nik Muhammad Zawawi bin Salleh [Pasir Puteh]
addressees: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Datuk Dr. Nik Muhammad Zawawi bin Salleh [Pasir Puteh]
addressees: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: Thank you, Your Honor.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Datuk Dr. Nik Muhammad Zawawi bin Salleh [Pasir Puteh]

edus.text: He ran a little away from the question
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Datuk Dr. Nik Muhammad Zawawi bin Salleh [Pasir Puteh]

edus.text: but I am very interested
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Datuk Dr. Nik Muhammad Zawawi bin Salleh [Pasir Puteh]

edus.text: because when it is mentioned, it is true,
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Datuk Dr. Nik Muhammad Zawawi bin Salleh [Pasir Puteh]

edus.text: if we look at whether it is an oil issue or a toll issue, a party election issue, a child wearing a skirt, this is all slander.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Datuk Dr. Nik Muhammad Zawawi bin Salleh [Pasir Puteh]

edus.text: Indeed we are open.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Datuk Dr. Nik Muhammad Zawawi bin Salleh [Pasir Puteh]

edus.text: Indeed, I believe we have platforms that can be provided and the government from time to time will examine the proposals as Yang Berhormat mentioned earlier so that the people become smarter, more wise, more concerned and more literate, more understanding and fluent about democracy.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Datuk Dr. Nik Muhammad Zawawi bin Salleh [Pasir Puteh]

edus.text: So it became a democracy, not 'demo kasi'.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Datuk Dr. Nik Muhammad Zawawi bin Salleh [Pasir Puteh]

edus.text: 'Demo kasi' is where I give you RM5, you come out and vote for me.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Datuk Dr. Nik Muhammad Zawawi bin Salleh [Pasir Puteh]

edus.text: For example ya.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Datuk Dr. Nik Muhammad Zawawi bin Salleh [Pasir Puteh]

edus.text: However, what is important at this time is that in the context of what we are talking about the question raised by Yang Berhormat Bandar Kuching earlier, it does not cover but about the aspect of the slander.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Datuk Dr. Nik Muhammad Zawawi bin Salleh [Pasir Puteh]

edus.text: What is interesting Mr. Speaker,
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: if I look at the numbers of the number of complaints cases, it is not a prosecution,
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: but the complaints received by SKMM.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: There are interesting trends,
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Datuk Dr. Nik Muhammad Zawawi bin Salleh [Pasir Puteh]

edus.text: for example in 2012 before the 2013 GE, the number of complaints received was 368.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Datuk Dr. Nik Muhammad Zawawi bin Salleh [Pasir Puteh]

edus.text: In 2013 after the GE, the number was 279, reduced.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Datuk Dr. Nik Muhammad Zawawi bin Salleh [Pasir Puteh]

edus.text: In 2017 before the 2018 GE, there were 210 complaints.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Datuk Dr. Nik Muhammad Zawawi bin Salleh [Pasir Puteh]

edus.text: In 2018, after the GE, there were 169 complaints.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Datuk Dr. Nik Muhammad Zawawi bin Salleh [Pasir Puteh]

edus.text: In fact in 2022, there were 161 complaints.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Datuk Dr. Nik Muhammad Zawawi bin Salleh [Pasir Puteh]

edus.text: So indeed, in that sense, the complaints were made mostly look like before the election.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Datuk Dr. Nik Muhammad Zawawi bin Salleh [Pasir Puteh]

edus.text: However, to rely on this act and section, for me the process is quite slow.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Datuk Dr. Nik Muhammad Zawawi bin Salleh [Pasir Puteh]

edus.text: That's why to refute or correct the facts, SKMM has a body, there is a unit named actually.my to clarify, correct false information that is not correct.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Datuk Dr. Nik Muhammad Zawawi bin Salleh [Pasir Puteh]

edus.text: While for BERNAMA, there is mycheck.my to confirm that something is conveyed correctly or not.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Datuk Dr. Nik Muhammad Zawawi bin Salleh [Pasir Puteh]

edus.text: So, I recommend Members of Parliament to use the platforms that have been mentioned earlier.my and mycheck.my to confirm the information.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Datuk Dr. Nik Muhammad Zawawi bin Salleh [Pasir Puteh]

edus.text: Good, thank you Honorable Minister.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: Your Honor, the session for Minister's Question Time is now over today.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: I thank you.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: Secretary.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: [ Minister's Question Time session ends ]
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

0: Tuan Yang di-Pertua said, Assalamualaikum warahmatullahi wabarakatuh and greetings.
1: Tuan Yang di-Pertua said, Let's start the Minister's Question Time and invite the Honorable Tuan Sim Tze Tzin, Bayan Baru.
2: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru] said, Thank you Mr. Speaker.
3: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru] said, Good morning to the teachers and also the headmasters here, in this House.
4: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru] said, [ Applause ]
5: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru] said, I would like to represent the teachers out there to bring their hearts to the teachers' ministers, teachers' ministers.
6: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru] said, Tuan Sim Tze Tzin asked the Minister of Education to state whether the Ministry of Education will conduct a technical audit on the IDentity Management System ( idMe ), the Ministry of Education Integrated System ( MOEIS ) which often experiences technical disruptions that make it difficult for the duties of tens of thousands of teachers.
7: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru] said, State the development expenses of this system and what action will be taken by the Ministry of Education against failed vendor companies?
8: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek] said, Bismillahi Rahmani Rahim.
9: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek] said, Assalamualaikum warahmatullahi wabarakatuh and good morning.
10: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek] said, Thank you my friend Yang Berhormat Bayan Baru.
11: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek] said, For your information, the Malaysian Ministry of Education realizes that there is a access disruption to the Identity Management System ( idMe ) and the MoE Integrated System ( MOEIS ).
12: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek] said, The MoE detected the disruption starting on 19 January 2023 due to technical issues and system use issues.
13: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek] said, The issue was resolved on 11 February 2023.
14: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek] said, The system's performance continues to be monitored to ensure that it is always operating well to minimize access disruptions.
15: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek] said, The MoE has identified the root of the problem to the entire system taking into account the overall system management as well as competency personnel to further strengthen the implementation of the system.
16: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek] said, As of 16 March 2023 Your Honor, a total of 89 percent of schools across the country have finished including data in the Integrated Assessment Management System under MOEIS through idMe.
17: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek] said, While the rest have the option to include data either through this management system or offline.
18: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek] said, Despite being given the option,
19: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek] said, there are three states that use the Integrated Assessment Management System ( SPPB ) 100 percent, namely the states of Kelantan, Sarawak and the Federal Territory of Labuan.
20: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek] said, While the state of Perlis reached 99 percent of the filling into the system.
21: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek] said, I would like to thank all the teachers who were patient when this system was in a lawsuit,
22: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek] said, even giving full cooperation when the MoE did a visit
23: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek] said, and was ready with the hybrid system,
24: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek] said, while we tried to improve the efficiency of this system.
25: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek] said, For your information, online classroom assessment involves several modules that are developed separately.
26: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek] said, The modules are idME, MOEIS Institutional Modul, MOEIS Student Modul and SPPB.
27: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek] said, MOEIS is developed internally
28: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek] said, while idMe and SPPB are developed in production to two different companies.
29: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek] said, These two systems are obtained in a quote and open tender in line with the Government Procurement Circular based on the ceiling price that has been set in the tender.
30: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek] said, For your information, the MoE will not compromise on any violation of the terms and conditions that have been set for the company that implements this system.
31: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek] said, For your information, the MoE is ready and open for any in-house technical inquiry and audit
32: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek] said, if there are allegations regarding the violation of the procedure for the implementation of this system.
33: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek] said, That's it, thank you Mr. Speaker.
34: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru] said, Thank you head teacher.
35: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru] said, Earlier I asked the Honorable Minister to answer the cost of developing this project.
36: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru] said, That's the first question.
37: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru] said, It's clear that this system failed and this is not new.
38: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru] said, There used to be many complaints from teachers out there.
39: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru] said, It should be focused on educating our children
40: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru] said, but had to key in data until 4am.
41: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru] said, I think this is an injustice
42: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru] said, and also torture to our teachers.
43: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru] said, So, I hope the ministry is firm in this regard.
44: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru] said, I hope and request that the Honorable Minister call the National Audit Department, look into whether there is any abuse of power or failures?
45: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru] said, Make sure that this new system is improved so
46: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru] said, that our teachers can focus on learning our children.
47: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru] said, Thank you.
48: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek] said, Thank you, Your Honor.
49: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek] said, I record my gratitude for your concern for the issue
50: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek] said, and we do take notice of those matters.
51: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek] said, Therefore, I mentioned earlier, Your Honor, among the quick actions we are making include providing a hybrid system
52: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek] said, and also visiting the assistance we offer to these teachers to help in their process fill in the information.
53: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek] said, Your Honor, I would also like to inform you that we will work with the Administrative Modernization and Management Planning Unit ( MAMPU ) for the implementation of technical audits in this system.
54: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek] said, The result of this audit is to improve the existing system in the planning of the upcoming MoE system.
55: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek] said, We expect this audit, Your Honor, to be carried out in the second quarter of 2023.
56: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek] said, As I mentioned earlier, the MoE does not compromise with any or any relaxation of terms or any failure in the procedures that have been set in the company that implements this system.
57: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek] said, Thank you, Your Honor.
58: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru] said, Honorable Minister, the cost of development.
59: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek] said, Your Honor, the cost for the idMe procurement contract value is as much as RM454,000
60: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek] said, while the SPPB is as much as RM1.05 million.

62: Tuan Jamaludin bin Yahya [Pasir Salak] said, Okay.
63: Tuan Jamaludin bin Yahya [Pasir Salak] said, Thank you Mr. Speaker, Honorable Minister, my question is,
64: Tuan Jamaludin bin Yahya [Pasir Salak] said, does the Ministry of Education want to stop this idMe?
65: Tuan Jamaludin bin Yahya [Pasir Salak] said, This is because what happens is a small survey that is used, the data to be included is very large.
66: Tuan Jamaludin bin Yahya [Pasir Salak] said, So, when we do that, what happens, teachers want to include data.
67: Tuan Jamaludin bin Yahya [Pasir Salak] said, Teachers put data in two ways.
68: Tuan Jamaludin bin Yahya [Pasir Salak] said, First, manually.
69: Tuan Jamaludin bin Yahya [Pasir Salak] said, Second, through this idMe,
70: Tuan Jamaludin bin Yahya [Pasir Salak] said, so two things that teachers have to do
71: Tuan Jamaludin bin Yahya [Pasir Salak] said, while we're trying to reduce the burden of these teachers.
72: Tuan Jamaludin bin Yahya [Pasir Salak] said, What is the comment of the Honorable Minister?
73: Tuan Jamaludin bin Yahya [Pasir Salak] said, Thank you.

75: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek] said, Thank you, Honorable Pasir Salak.
76: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek] said, I appreciate and record thank you for that view.
77: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek] said, Yes, we take into account everything related to the burdens of this teacher's duties.
78: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek] said, In close regard to this system, I remember it is also important for me to record that we will be more careful
79: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek] said, and give enough time to all parties involved in the ministry to review, improve and most importantly also especially in technical system testing activities as well as user change management activities including a pilot implementation approach in an effort
80: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek] said, to ensure the smooth use of all those systems.
81: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek] said, Currently, Your Honor, we do not have any stance to abolish or stop this system
82: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek] said, but we will improve
83: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek] said, because we see that this system still has good interests towards reducing the burden of teachers as well.
84: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek] said, At the same time, we are committed to improving this system.
85: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek] said, Thank you, Your Honor.
86: Tuan Yang di-Pertua said, Thank you, Honorable Minister.
87: Tuan Yang di-Pertua said, Next, I invite Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali, Honorable Kapar.
88: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar] said, Bismillahi Rahmani Rahim.
89: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar] said, Thank you, Mr. Speaker.
90: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar] said, One of the questions or complaints I have received since becoming a Member of Parliament is about this question.
91: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar] said, Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali asked the Minister of Health to state whether the ministry has made a decision to prohibit patients from using health clinic services closer to their homes after the re-delimitation of the constituency.
92: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa] said, Thank you Honorable Kapar.
93: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa] said, Thank you Mr. Speaker.
94: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa] said, Mr. Speaker, the ministry is very committed to providing health services to all citizens.
95: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa] said, All health personnel at triages or registration counters are reminded not to reject any presence of any customer to seek treatment at a health clinic to meet the No Wrong Door Policy approach that has been implemented through personalized care or family doctor concept to ensure continuous health care
96: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa] said, and can not be used as an excuse to reject customers who come from outside the health clinic cooperative area.
97: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa] said, For example, patients who receive treatment at health clinics in the Kapar Parliamentary area can seek treatment at nearby health clinics, for example in the Bukit Raja Parliamentary area
98: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa] said, if the health clinic is close to the patient's residence for the comfort and convenience of the patient.
99: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa] said, Thank you.
100: Tuan Yang di-Pertua said, Good, Honorable Kapar.
101: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar] said, Thank you Mr. Speaker.
102: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar] said, Thank you Honorable Minister.
103: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar] said, So, indeed that is the code of ethics for health.
104: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar] said, I want to give a setting– That is ideal.

109: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar] said, When that has existed and when it is completed, and cooperational, I was asked by the clinic to tell the people of the Klang Strait, Sungai Udang, Kampung Delek, those that don't know that this one already exist,
110: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar] said, it is already operating, they can go there, no need to go to Pandamaran Health Clinic.
111: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar] said, Unfortunately, unfortunately what is happening now Mr. Speaker, their house after the redelineation of GE14,

113: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar] said, These people are separated from the health clinic from their house like from here to the Member of Parliament's Building.
114: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar] said, That's it, as close as that.
115: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar] said, So, they say they can't accept it, they are told ...
116: Tuan Yang di-Pertua said, What is the question?
117: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar] said, ... go to Pandamaran Health Clinic.
118: Tuan Yang di-Pertua said, Honorable Kapar, the question?
119: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar] said, So, I want to ask– When was the one earlier, open door policy, right?
120: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar] said, Please let me know, this should be the policy already.
121: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar] said, So, why didn't that happen?
122: Tuan Yang di-Pertua said, The question is Honorable Kapar, the question.
123: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar] said, And maybe is there a reason for not having enough staff?
124: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar] said, Not enough medication?
125: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar] said, Not enough what?
