131: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa] said, So, if it's true to happen ...
132: Tuan Yang di-Pertua said, Very specific.
133: Tuan Yang di-Pertua said, Please.
134: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa] said, If it is true, Your Honor,
135: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa] said, I request a complaint
136: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa] said, and we will investigate this matter
137: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa] said, and take appropriate action, God willing.
138: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa] said, Thank you.
139: Dato’ Muhammad Bakhtiar bin Wan Chik [Balik Pulau] said, Additional questions.
140: Tuan Syed Ibrahim bin Syed Noh [Ledang] said, [ Stands up ]
141: Tuan Yang di-Pertua said, Please.
142: Dato’ Muhammad Bakhtiar bin Wan Chik [Balik Pulau] said, Balik Pulau huh?
143: Tuan Yang di-Pertua said, Honorable Balik Pulau.
144: Dato’ Muhammad Bakhtiar bin Wan Chik [Balik Pulau] said, Thank you Mr. Speaker, very sure.
145: Dato’ Muhammad Bakhtiar bin Wan Chik [Balik Pulau] said, Okay, I would like to ask the Honorable Minister of Health about the dress code that is now viral,
146: Dato’ Muhammad Bakhtiar bin Wan Chik [Balik Pulau] said, which if they wear certain clothes they can not receive health services at clinics or hospitals.
147: Dato’ Muhammad Bakhtiar bin Wan Chik [Balik Pulau] said, So, I would like to ask
148: Dato’ Muhammad Bakhtiar bin Wan Chik [Balik Pulau] said, if the actual dress code or does the Ministry of Health accept anyone in emergency cases, regardless of how to dress and so on?
149: Dato’ Muhammad Bakhtiar bin Wan Chik [Balik Pulau] said, Thank you.
150: Tuan Yang di-Pertua said, Please, Honorable Minister.
151: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa] said, Thank you, Your Honor.
152: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa] said, Mr. Speaker, I am aware of this matter and the things that have been viral in recent weeks.
153: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa] said, So, I want to tell you that in principle, every patient, Your Honor, must be given treatment priority regardless of race or dress code.
154: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa] said, So, every medical practitioner including medical officers needs to take care of their ethics after we-
155: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa] said, We actually have a oath, we take a oath
156: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa] said, or are called a hypocrite oath that is pledged by especially doctors and medical practitioners including the willingness to help patients as best as possible.
157: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa] said, So, I think maybe what happens is a communication problem
158: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa] said, and usually if we get a complaint, we take immediate action to ensure that the matter does not happen again.
159: Tuan Yang di-Pertua said, Well thank you, I invite Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen, Honorable City of Kuching.
160: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching] said, Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Kuching City] ask the Minister of Communications and Digital to state the ministry's intention to amend the provisions of section 2 of the Communications
161: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching] said, and Multimedia Act 1998 [ Act 588 ] to ensure it is not misused.
162: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil] said, Thank you, Mr. Speaker.
163: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil] said, Thank you, Your Honor.
164: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil] said, The Ministry of Communications and Digital and the Malaysian Communications and Multimedia Commission ( SKMM ) are currently studying the amendment to the Communications and Multimedia Act 1998, where the comprehensive approach will take into account all existing legal provisions also ensure that any punishment is effective and there is no element of persecution.
165: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil] said, Among the proposed amendments submitted by SKMM
166: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil] said, but have not yet been decided
167: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil] said, and are still in discussion including the proposed amendment to section 233 of Act 588.
168: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil] said, The application of section 233 of Act 588 or the Communications and Multimedia Act 1998 is generally to deal with the misuse of network facilities, network services or application services, including social media platforms for the purpose of dissemination of content that is obscene, incest, false, threatening or obscene with the intention of hurting, mistreating, threatening or disturbing others.
169: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil] said, For the information of this honorable House, Act 588 has not yet been amended.
170: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil] said, Meaning, 25 years have passed
171: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil] said, since this law was drafted, enacted and approved.
172: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil] said, We must know, 25 years ago,
173: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil] said, now and 25 years to come, the state of technology, use, the existing platforms are also very different.
174: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil] said, So, when the ministry examines as a whole, we do not intend only to look at section 233.
175: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil] said, However, since a major change is happening,
176: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil] said, if in the past we only used maybe 2G, 3G, now 5G and then how?
177: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil] said, We must intend to see the objectives.
178: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil] said, Among the main objectives for the amendment is to encourage the development of the communication and multimedia industry for future needs ( fit for future ), improve the security aspect of the network following the increase in public consumption and dependence on digital services and there are several other things.
179: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil] said, However, because we are still in the discussion process,
180: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil] said,  my hope is to get feedback from either Members of Parliament, among NGOs, the public, legal experts for us to improve so
181: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil] said, that there is no abuse of power or abuse of this section for political purposes.
182: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil] said, Thank you.
183: Tuan Yang di-Pertua said, Please Dear City of Kuching.
184: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching] said, Thank you Mr. Speaker.
185: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching] said, Thank you Honorable Minister for the detailed answer.
186: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching] said, I strongly agree that the act was 25 years ago
187: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching] said, and we have to amend it to be in line with the development of time and for now's use.
188: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching] said, So, we know that an act should be used for good.
189: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching] said, I know to prevent pornographic materials and so on and most complaints are about the issue.
190: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching] said, However, if it is not amended,
191: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching] said, it is still open to abuse.
192: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching] said, So my question is,
193: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching] said, what steps can the ministry take to ensure what is supposed to be for good but not misuse?
194: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching] said, Maybe for now, there is no prosecution in those obscene cases.
195: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching] said, Can discuss with the Ministry of Home Affairs.
196: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil] said, Good, thank you, Your Honor.
197: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil] said, There are several figures that I would like to state Mr. Speaker.
198: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil] said, Actually, what is quite interesting when we look into from January 2009 to January 31, 2023, the number of complaints received by SKMM based on the delivery element is 2,804.
199: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil] said, This is the complaint received.
200: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil] said, Of that number, as many as 1,625 or 57.9 percent are complaints about pornographic content.
201: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil] said, While the false information is as much as 564 or 20.1 percent and obscene content which amounts to 541 or 19.2 percent.
202: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil] said, Only based on the figures provided by this SKMM, when we state, more than 80 percent of the complaints received, not those investigated or those subject to penalties or punishments brought to court for example.
203: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil] said, More than 80 percent are not obscene complaints.
204: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil] said, In fact, we see that the majority are pornographic content.
205: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil] said, So from there we see, in general, this act is not misused.
206: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil] said, At least, not under the supervision of this ministry.
207: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil] said, It is quite interesting when we look into it, the complaints made throughout from 2009 to 2023, there are indeed patterns that are very interesting Mr. Speaker.
208: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil] said, For example, the highest number of complaints in 2010 was delivery complaints through SMS.
209: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil] said, If at that time in 2010,
210: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil] said, there were 243 complaints but today,
211: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil] said, I give an example as of 2022, only two complaints received through SMS format.
212: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil] said, At one point in 2009, it showed the highest number of complaints about blogs or websites which is 52 complaints but as of 2022, only eight.
213: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil] said, So we do see that there is a change.
214: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil] said, What is interesting is that the complaints received for WhatsApp show a trend that lasts from 2015 to 2022 around 40 to 50 complaints every year.
215: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil] said, So, we see the pattern of using the platforms as well, a matter that is being taken into account by the ministry.
216: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil] said, However, we will discuss with all parties including the Ministry of Home Affairs to make sure that this act and section in particular are not misused.
217: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil] said, Thank you.
218: Tuan Yang di-Pertua said, Please, Honorable Pasir Puteh.
219: Datuk Dr. Nik Muhammad Zawawi bin Salleh [Pasir Puteh] said, Thank you Mr. Speaker and thank you Honorable Minister for giving an explanation.
220: Datuk Dr. Nik Muhammad Zawawi bin Salleh [Pasir Puteh] said, I examined the answer given, where the issue involving the amendment of the Communications and Digital Act is for us to ensure that our country is running properly.
221: Datuk Dr. Nik Muhammad Zawawi bin Salleh [Pasir Puteh] said, I want to talk about check and balance.
222: Datuk Dr. Nik Muhammad Zawawi bin Salleh [Pasir Puteh] said, We see in political issues, many of these leaders speak without facts and are exposed.
223: Datuk Dr. Nik Muhammad Zawawi bin Salleh [Pasir Puteh] said, It affects the election.
224: Datuk Dr. Nik Muhammad Zawawi bin Salleh [Pasir Puteh] said, So my question is,
225: Datuk Dr. Nik Muhammad Zawawi bin Salleh [Pasir Puteh] said, does the Malaysian Government today want to move forward by featuring political figures to have a dialogue openly and live broadcast in our country between the party presidents?
226: Datuk Dr. Nik Muhammad Zawawi bin Salleh [Pasir Puteh] said, Because we don't want time to be in the opposition, oil goes down, remove tolls.
227: Datuk Dr. Nik Muhammad Zawawi bin Salleh [Pasir Puteh] said, When ruling, there is nothing.
228: Datuk Dr. Nik Muhammad Zawawi bin Salleh [Pasir Puteh] said, So, we want the statement made, let there be a check and balance.
229: Datuk Dr. Nik Muhammad Zawawi bin Salleh [Pasir Puteh] said, Let the leaders speak freely.
230: Datuk Dr. Nik Muhammad Zawawi bin Salleh [Pasir Puteh] said, Thank you.
231: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil] said, Thank you, Your Honor.
232: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil] said, He ran a little away from the question
233: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil] said, but I am very interested
234: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil] said, because when it is mentioned, it is true,
235: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil] said, if we look at whether it is an oil issue or a toll issue, a party election issue, a child wearing a skirt, this is all slander.
236: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil] said, Indeed we are open.
237: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil] said, Indeed, I believe we have platforms that can be provided and the government from time to time will examine the proposals as Yang Berhormat mentioned earlier so that the people become smarter, more wise, more concerned and more literate, more understanding and fluent about democracy.
238: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil] said, So it became a democracy, not 'demo kasi'.
239: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil] said, 'Demo kasi' is where I give you RM5, you come out and vote for me.
240: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil] said, For example ya.
241: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil] said, However, what is important at this time is that in the context of what we are talking about the question raised by Yang Berhormat Bandar Kuching earlier, it does not cover but about the aspect of the slander.
242: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil] said, What is interesting Mr. Speaker,
243: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil] said, if I look at the numbers of the number of complaints cases, it is not a prosecution,
244: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil] said, but the complaints received by SKMM.
245: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil] said, There are interesting trends,
246: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil] said, for example in 2012 before the 2013 GE, the number of complaints received was 368.
247: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil] said, In 2013 after the GE, the number was 279, reduced.
248: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil] said, In 2017 before the 2018 GE, there were 210 complaints.
249: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil] said, In 2018, after the GE, there were 169 complaints.
250: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil] said, In fact in 2022, there were 161 complaints.
251: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil] said, So indeed, in that sense, the complaints were made mostly look like before the election.
252: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil] said, However, to rely on this act and section, for me the process is quite slow.
253: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil] said, That's why to refute or correct the facts, SKMM has a body, there is a unit named actually.my to clarify, correct false information that is not correct.
254: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil] said, While for BERNAMA, there is mycheck.my to confirm that something is conveyed correctly or not.
255: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil] said, So, I recommend Members of Parliament to use the platforms that have been mentioned earlier.my and mycheck.my to confirm the information.
256: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil] said, Thank you.
257: Tuan Yang di-Pertua said, Good, thank you Honorable Minister.
258: Tuan Yang di-Pertua said, Your Honor, the session for Minister's Question Time is now over today.
259: Tuan Yang di-Pertua said, I thank you.
260: Tuan Yang di-Pertua said, Secretary.
261: Tuan Yang di-Pertua said, [ Minister's Question Time session ends ]

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, as you already know,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: I have just arrived from Turkiye.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: I have informed on Tuesday to the Honorable Members that my desire to reach Nurdagi in Gaziantep alone.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: I am with the Foreign Minister and Minister in the Prime Minister's Department, arrived and continued to land at the nearby airport to Nurdagi.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: I mean to convey,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: to state
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: that our forces consisting of SMART, NADMA, Fire and Rescue Department, Civil Defense Force, Armed Forces and several NGOs, including MERCY and MAPIM have carried out extraordinary duties and services.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: [ Applause ]
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: I would like to use this Parliament Council to state that we are very fortunate and indebted.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Since when we met the Mayor, the Mayor, then the Governor who greeted us until the President's Main Advisor, Ibrahim Khalid and President Recep Toyyip Erdogan himself.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: All of them mention that the Malaysian team was among the earliest to provide excellent service.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: [ Applause ]
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Save five buried lives, two meters deep, with equipment brought from Malaysia that is very sophisticated
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: and can also dig deep
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: and bring out hundreds of other bodies.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: The Malaysian team that is in the ground zero has reached almost 200 people, not included with additional entourage that has been sent to Syria.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: The latest number of casualties is 41,232 people, 35,418 in Turkiye and 5,814 in Syria.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: This number according to the President is expected to increase day by day.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: For Ops Syria, the government has sent a reconnaissance team led by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs' TKSU and a delegation of 21 people from various agencies and NGOs with special aircraft of the Malaysian Armed Forces.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: They will also provide guidance for us to expedite the next assistance.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: I don't want to explain about the epicenter (epicentre) and the severe effects.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: However, what we are witnessing is quite extraordinary.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: If you follow the media coverage
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: and also the briefing presented,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: the tremors exceed the Nagasaki-Hiroshima bomb.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: President Toyyip Erdogan started the meeting first, expressing his special appreciation to the Yang di-Pertuan Agong for inaugurating the Opening of Parliament, having stated, conveying his condolences to the victims in Tukiye, especially.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: This was done in Parliament
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: and he asked me to convey this appreciation not only to the Yang di-Pertuan Agong, Mr. Yang di-Pertua and 222 members of Parliament who participated.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: [ Applause ]
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: There are indeed those who ask, why in this case Malaysia is taking a relatively forward step
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: and some say excessively.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: I would like to clarify that first of all,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: the damage rate is quite a large scale that is rarely before.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Unless it is a tsunami time involving Aceh Darussalam.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Secondly, special friendships, not only personal but among the two countries.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Thirdly, the information that is not known is that the country of Turkey has actually previously provided direct and indirect assistance to several government efforts,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: including government companies involved in Turkey, which reach hundreds of millions of ringgit.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: This is rare in our bilateral relations with other countries.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Therefore, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs took additional initiatives in this regard.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: As of today, we have managed to raise funds that are quite proud of RM50 million.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: [ Applause ]
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Most of it is specifically aimed at Turkey,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: including for example MAHB, Tan Sri Syed Mokhtar Group, Ranhill which has large business operations in Turkey.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: That's why we distribute RM40 million to Turkey and RM10 million to Syria.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: To express our appreciation to companies and friends who have helped big, I choose to mention some.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Although we can not underestimate the sincerity of university children for example from Universiti Pertahanan Nasional Malaysia RM2,000 collected from students and staff.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: [ Applause ]
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: The largest amount from MAHB which contributes as much as EUR5 million
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: is equivalent to RM23.5 million.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: This is the largest.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: That's specifically to Turkiye.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Followed by Tan Sri Syed Mokhtar and Albukhary Foundation RM10 million.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: [ Applause ]
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: I am also grateful to the Gabungan Dewan Perniagaan dan Perindustrian Cina Malaysia (ACCCIM) which extended USD1 million equivalent to RM4.4 million which combines several Chinese business companies through ACCCIM.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Tuanku Sultan Johor was among the first to donate also USD1 million equivalent to RM4.4 million.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: [ Applause ]

edus.text: So, the amount reached RM50 million.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: When I went down to meet friends in SMART and the surroundings and part of the group, I was really touched.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: The work was two weeks ago,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: it seemed tired
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: and entered the district they were not used to.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: There has never been a team of our country that worked in winter or winter.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: That's very cold.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: I really felt very tired without complete clothes.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: A few hours there, talking to dozens and hundreds of them.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: No one complained of fatigue,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: complained about food and drink.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Everything said they were grateful to Allah Taala for being able to work.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: [ Applause ]
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Serving well.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: [ Applause ]
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Perfecting congregational prayers and also prepared food and drinks.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Most of them are in-canned fast food.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: So, that's why I am motivated to convey this view to the Parliament Council to show that we Members of Parliament all feel the need to express our appreciation to them.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: How can we add meaning to this appreciation?
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Firstly, we will certainly issue a certificate of appreciation
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: and I suggest a special service medal for all those on duty.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: [ Applause ]
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: I suggest that we arrange a special allowance for every serving person.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: [ Applause ]
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: The special allowance is based on the days they are on duty.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Some will reach two weeks.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: In fact, SMART is his two-week period.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: However, in my trial with President Erdogan, he requested that it be continued
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: because there are too many dead bodies that need our efforts
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: and I agree for them to continue.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: If there are some people who have health problems,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: they can be allowed to return immediately.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: This special allowance is set to each individual and according to their service period
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: and I will discuss with the Treasury about the appropriate amount.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: So, thank you Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: I just want to use this Council so that all Members of Parliament express their appreciation.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: We have recorded our condolences.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: However, special appreciation to all friends who served so brilliantly in Turkey and God willing in Syria.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: [ Applause ]
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, may I ask the Honorable Prime Minister for a question?
edus.speaker: Tuan Ahmad Tarmizi bin Sulaiman [Sik]

edus.text: Question?
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: Yes.
edus.speaker: Tuan Ahmad Tarmizi bin Sulaiman [Sik]

edus.text: Query.
edus.speaker: Tuan Ahmad Tarmizi bin Sulaiman [Sik]

edus.text: How many missions?
edus.speaker: Tuan Ahmad Tarmizi bin Sulaiman [Sik]

edus.text: Okay, just give one.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: Yes.
edus.speaker: Tuan Ahmad Tarmizi bin Sulaiman [Sik]

edus.text: Thank you Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Tuan Ahmad Tarmizi bin Sulaiman [Sik]

edus.text: Thank you Honorable Prime Minister.
edus.speaker: Tuan Ahmad Tarmizi bin Sulaiman [Sik]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Congratulations to the efforts and steps of the Malaysian Government for helping the people of Turkey and Syria.
edus.speaker: Tuan Ahmad Tarmizi bin Sulaiman [Sik]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: My first question is in terms of the specific amount given by the Malaysian Government to Turkey itself.
edus.speaker: Tuan Ahmad Tarmizi bin Sulaiman [Sik]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: It was mentioned earlier that corporate companies and so on.
edus.speaker: Tuan Ahmad Tarmizi bin Sulaiman [Sik]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: We also want to be informed to all the people how much is given by the government itself?
edus.speaker: Tuan Ahmad Tarmizi bin Sulaiman [Sik]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Secondly, in terms of coordination on Wisma Putra's side, when it was informed that many volunteers or NGOs would move to Turkey.
edus.speaker: Tuan Ahmad Tarmizi bin Sulaiman [Sik]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Some have already moved, who organize the schedules I also see being moved.
edus.speaker: Tuan Ahmad Tarmizi bin Sulaiman [Sik]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: So, if possible on Wisma Putra's side there is a unit to coordinate this movement
edus.speaker: Tuan Ahmad Tarmizi bin Sulaiman [Sik]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: so that the launch or schedule is easy
edus.speaker: Tuan Ahmad Tarmizi bin Sulaiman [Sik]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: and also seen that our volunteers are direct to ground zero which is suitable for them to help.
edus.speaker: Tuan Ahmad Tarmizi bin Sulaiman [Sik]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: This includes on the part of the Perikatan Nasional Members of Parliament themselves will make a mission on March 2 until March 7
edus.speaker: Tuan Ahmad Tarmizi bin Sulaiman [Sik]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: which will be led by the Honorable Kubang Kerian.
edus.speaker: Tuan Ahmad Tarmizi bin Sulaiman [Sik]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: So, God willing, we will help what is being done by the Malaysian Government.
edus.speaker: Tuan Ahmad Tarmizi bin Sulaiman [Sik]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Thank you very much.
edus.speaker: Tuan Ahmad Tarmizi bin Sulaiman [Sik]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Thank you, Honorable Sik.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Indeed, I admit that I missed it earlier, I did not mention the contribution.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Last week, the Cabinet approved USD1 million (RM4.4 million).
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: However, in the Cabinet meeting, this Friday, I will propose the consideration of the Cabinet to add a little more considering the very difficult situation there.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Second, regarding the coordination carried out by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: I will ask them to contact Yang Berhormat Kubang Kerian to help coordinate the visits of the Honorable friends over there to go to ground zero.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

67: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim] said, Berjaya Group via Mercy RM500,000.
68: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim] said, IOI Corporation Berhad RM500,000.
69: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim] said, Ranhill Holdings Berhad RM300,000.
70: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim] said, Mikrolink Solutions Berhad RM100,000.
71: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim] said, YHA Travel and Tours RM100,000.
72: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim] said, So, the amount reached RM50 million.
73: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim] said, When I went down to meet friends in SMART and the surroundings and part of the group, I was really touched.
74: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim] said, The work was two weeks ago,
75: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim] said, it seemed tired
76: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim] said, and entered the district they were not used to.
77: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim] said, There has never been a team of our country that worked in winter or winter.
78: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim] said, That's very cold.
79: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim] said, I really felt very tired without complete clothes.
80: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim] said, A few hours there, talking to dozens and hundreds of them.
81: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim] said, No one complained of fatigue,
82: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim] said, complained about food and drink.
83: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim] said, Everything said they were grateful to Allah Taala for being able to work.
84: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim] said, [ Applause ]
85: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim] said, Serving well.
86: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim] said, [ Applause ]
87: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim] said, Perfecting congregational prayers and also prepared food and drinks.
88: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim] said, Most of them are in-canned fast food.
89: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim] said, So, that's why I am motivated to convey this view to the Parliament Council to show that we Members of Parliament all feel the need to express our appreciation to them.
90: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim] said, How can we add meaning to this appreciation?
91: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim] said, Firstly, we will certainly issue a certificate of appreciation
92: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim] said, and I suggest a special service medal for all those on duty.
93: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim] said, [ Applause ]
94: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim] said, I suggest that we arrange a special allowance for every serving person.
95: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim] said, [ Applause ]
96: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim] said, The special allowance is based on the days they are on duty.
97: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim] said, Some will reach two weeks.
98: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim] said, In fact, SMART is his two-week period.
99: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim] said, However, in my trial with President Erdogan, he requested that it be continued
100: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim] said, because there are too many dead bodies that need our efforts
101: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim] said, and I agree for them to continue.
102: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim] said, If there are some people who have health problems,
103: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim] said, they can be allowed to return immediately.
104: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim] said, This special allowance is set to each individual and according to their service period
105: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim] said, and I will discuss with the Treasury about the appropriate amount.
106: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim] said, So, thank you Mr. Speaker.
107: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim] said, I just want to use this Council so that all Members of Parliament express their appreciation.
108: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim] said, We have recorded our condolences.
109: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim] said, However, special appreciation to all friends who served so brilliantly in Turkey and God willing in Syria.
110: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim] said, Thank you.
111: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim] said, [ Applause ]
112: Tuan Ahmad Tarmizi bin Sulaiman [Sik] said, Mr. Speaker, may I ask the Honorable Prime Minister for a question?
113: Tuan Yang di-Pertua said, Question?
114: Tuan Ahmad Tarmizi bin Sulaiman [Sik] said, Yes.
115: Tuan Ahmad Tarmizi bin Sulaiman [Sik] said, Query.
116: Tuan Ahmad Tarmizi bin Sulaiman [Sik] said, How many missions?
117: Tuan Yang di-Pertua said, Okay, just give one.
118: Tuan Ahmad Tarmizi bin Sulaiman [Sik] said, Yes.
119: Tuan Ahmad Tarmizi bin Sulaiman [Sik] said, Thank you Mr. Speaker.
120: Tuan Ahmad Tarmizi bin Sulaiman [Sik] said, Thank you Honorable Prime Minister.
121: Tuan Ahmad Tarmizi bin Sulaiman [Sik] said, Congratulations to the efforts and steps of the Malaysian Government for helping the people of Turkey and Syria.
122: Tuan Ahmad Tarmizi bin Sulaiman [Sik] said, My first question is in terms of the specific amount given by the Malaysian Government to Turkey itself.
123: Tuan Ahmad Tarmizi bin Sulaiman [Sik] said, It was mentioned earlier that corporate companies and so on.
124: Tuan Ahmad Tarmizi bin Sulaiman [Sik] said, We also want to be informed to all the people how much is given by the government itself?
125: Tuan Ahmad Tarmizi bin Sulaiman [Sik] said, Secondly, in terms of coordination on Wisma Putra's side, when it was informed that many volunteers or NGOs would move to Turkey.
126: Tuan Ahmad Tarmizi bin Sulaiman [Sik] said, Some have already moved, who organize the schedules I also see being moved.
127: Tuan Ahmad Tarmizi bin Sulaiman [Sik] said, So, if possible on Wisma Putra's side there is a unit to coordinate this movement
128: Tuan Ahmad Tarmizi bin Sulaiman [Sik] said, so that the launch or schedule is easy
129: Tuan Ahmad Tarmizi bin Sulaiman [Sik] said, and also seen that our volunteers are direct to ground zero which is suitable for them to help.
130: Tuan Ahmad Tarmizi bin Sulaiman [Sik] said, This includes on the part of the Perikatan Nasional Members of Parliament themselves will make a mission on March 2 until March 7
131: Tuan Ahmad Tarmizi bin Sulaiman [Sik] said, which will be led by the Honorable Kubang Kerian.
132: Tuan Ahmad Tarmizi bin Sulaiman [Sik] said, So, God willing, we will help what is being done by the Malaysian Government.
133: Tuan Ahmad Tarmizi bin Sulaiman [Sik] said, Thank you very much.
134: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim] said, Thank you, Honorable Sik.
135: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim] said, Indeed, I admit that I missed it earlier, I did not mention the contribution.
136: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim] said, Last week, the Cabinet approved USD1 million (RM4.4 million).
137: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim] said, However, in the Cabinet meeting, this Friday, I will propose the consideration of the Cabinet to add a little more considering the very difficult situation there.
138: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim] said, Second, regarding the coordination carried out by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
139: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim] said, I will ask them to contact Yang Berhormat Kubang Kerian to help coordinate the visits of the Honorable friends over there to go to ground zero.
140: Tuan Yang di-Pertua said, Thank you.

edus.text: Datuk Seri Sh Mohmed Puzi bin Sh Ali asked the Minister of Rural and Regional Development to state the Madani Government's plan and action plan
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Sh Mohmed Puzi bin Sh Ali [Pekan]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]

edus.text: in implementing the maintenance and repair of infrastructure and rural facilities after the flood from KKDW and related government agencies to help rural communities affected by the flood.
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Sh Mohmed Puzi bin Sh Ali [Pekan]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]

edus.text: How is the coordination made by the government to ensure that no victims are left behind from getting the aid?
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Sh Mohmed Puzi bin Sh Ali [Pekan]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, I would like to thank Yang Berhormat Pekan for this question.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Mohd Nor]

edus.text: However, I request permission from Mr. Yang di-Pertua and this honorable House to summarize this answer with not only the Ministry of Rural and Regional Development
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Mohd Nor]

edus.text: but also other ministries that are also involved in flood aid and also post-banjir.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, I would like to express my gratitude to the cooperation of various ministries, departments and agencies in not only helping flood victims
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Mohd Nor]

edus.text: but also solving post-banjir problems.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Mohd Nor]

edus.text: I would like to mention that there are three phases in helping this flood problem.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]
addressees: Datuk Seri Sh Mohmed Puzi bin Sh Ali [Pekan]
Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Mohd Nor]

edus.text: First of all in collaboration with METMalaysia.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]
addressees: Datuk Seri Sh Mohmed Puzi bin Sh Ali [Pekan]

edus.text: As the Central Disaster Chairman, I coordinate it with the state government and the district where METMalaysia gives an early warning
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]
addressees: Datuk Seri Sh Mohmed Puzi bin Sh Ali [Pekan]

edus.text: so that the transfer can be done before the rain reaches the highest level will cause flooding.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]
addressees: Datuk Seri Sh Mohmed Puzi bin Sh Ali [Pekan]

edus.text: Second, during the flood.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]
addressees: Datuk Seri Sh Mohmed Puzi bin Sh Ali [Pekan]

edus.text: Mobilization is done entirely by coordinating the involvement of local agencies and authorities together with NGOs to carry out the transfer.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]
addressees: Datuk Seri Sh Mohmed Puzi bin Sh Ali [Pekan]

edus.text: Thirdly, after the flood where we face problems,
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]
addressees: Datuk Seri Sh Mohmed Puzi bin Sh Ali [Pekan]

edus.text: usually not many people come to help after the flood, especially for house cleaning, hardware purchases and replacements of various other things.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]
addressees: Datuk Seri Sh Mohmed Puzi bin Sh Ali [Pekan]

edus.text: Therefore, we involve NGOs and volunteer bodies to do so.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]
addressees: Datuk Seri Sh Mohmed Puzi bin Sh Ali [Pekan]

edus.text: The role of KKDW together with NADMA, together with the Civil Defense Force, together with JAKOA, the Department of Social Welfare and various parties with the approach that we can no longer move silo.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]
addressees: Datuk Seri Sh Mohmed Puzi bin Sh Ali [Pekan]

edus.text: We must move adjustedly.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]
addressees: Datuk Seri Sh Mohmed Puzi bin Sh Ali [Pekan]

edus.text: Even with the state governments, the allocation given by the Prime Minister amounting to RM50 million for Kelantan and Terengganu shows
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]
addressees: Datuk Seri Sh Mohmed Puzi bin Sh Ali [Pekan]

edus.text: that empowerment is given to the Terengganu State Government and the Kelantan State Government to implement the allocation
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]
addressees: Datuk Seri Sh Mohmed Puzi bin Sh Ali [Pekan]

edus.text: by being coordinated by the ICU.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]
addressees: Datuk Seri Sh Mohmed Puzi bin Sh Ali [Pekan]

edus.text: In this regard, of course Yang Berhormat Pekan knows that Pekan is one of the areas that every year never escapes the grace of Allah Taala with excessive water down there and God willing we will also continue to provide assistance.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]
addressees: Datuk Seri Sh Mohmed Puzi bin Sh Ali [Pekan]

edus.text: Additional question Dear Pekan.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Mohd Nor]
addressees: Datuk Seri Sh Mohmed Puzi bin Sh Ali [Pekan]

edus.text: We understand that this flood also hit the population, especially in the interior, especially in the settlement areas of the Orang Asli community.
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Sh Mohmed Puzi bin Sh Ali [Pekan]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]

edus.text: `` 1010 I would like to ask, what actions are taken by the Ministry of Rural and Regional Development
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Sh Mohmed Puzi bin Sh Ali [Pekan]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]

edus.text: so that the Orang Asli community is always ready to face the flood disaster that occurs every year and what help is given to them?
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Sh Mohmed Puzi bin Sh Ali [Pekan]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Sh Mohmed Puzi bin Sh Ali [Pekan]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, for the Orang Asli Development Department ( JAKOA ), coincidentally the Director General is the younger sibling of our Deputy Speaker.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Mohd Nor]

edus.text: He is very active, even proactive.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]
addressees: Datuk Seri Sh Mohmed Puzi bin Sh Ali [Pekan]
Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Mohd Nor]

edus.text: What is done when an Orang Asli area is disconnected from its infrastructure,
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]
addressees: Datuk Seri Sh Mohmed Puzi bin Sh Ali [Pekan]

edus.text: what NADMA does is that the food aid is given before the flood occurs.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]
addressees: Datuk Seri Sh Mohmed Puzi bin Sh Ali [Pekan]

edus.text: When the flood occurs,
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]
addressees: Datuk Seri Sh Mohmed Puzi bin Sh Ali [Pekan]

edus.text: in collaboration with the Fire and Rescue Department and also the PDRM,
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]
addressees: Datuk Seri Sh Mohmed Puzi bin Sh Ali [Pekan]

edus.text: mobilization of aid and so on using airways.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]
addressees: Datuk Seri Sh Mohmed Puzi bin Sh Ali [Pekan]

edus.text: I would like to mention in this honorable House about the Temporary Transfer Center ( PPS ).
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]
addressees: Datuk Seri Sh Mohmed Puzi bin Sh Ali [Pekan]

edus.text: The approach we do is that apart from building PPS built in certain areas that are often flooded, in collaboration with the Ministry of Education, we have identified the schools used for PPS.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]
addressees: Datuk Seri Sh Mohmed Puzi bin Sh Ali [Pekan]

edus.text: What is done,
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]
addressees: Datuk Seri Sh Mohmed Puzi bin Sh Ali [Pekan]

edus.text: the allocation from NADMA is to build permanent halls in those schools.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]
addressees: Datuk Seri Sh Mohmed Puzi bin Sh Ali [Pekan]

edus.text: When there is a flood,
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]

edus.text: the hall is used as a PPS center.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]

edus.text: Outside of flood time, the hall is used by the school and also the local community.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]
addressees: Datuk Seri Sh Mohmed Puzi bin Sh Ali [Pekan]

edus.text: This is done after taking into account that the repair after the flood involves a high cost and this is certainly not fair for the Ministry of Education to bear it.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]
addressees: Datuk Seri Sh Mohmed Puzi bin Sh Ali [Pekan]

edus.text: So, these approaches outside the box, outside the silo are what we have done
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]
addressees: Datuk Seri Sh Mohmed Puzi bin Sh Ali [Pekan]

edus.text: and the most important thing is that the delivery system must reach the target group.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]
addressees: Datuk Seri Sh Mohmed Puzi bin Sh Ali [Pekan]

edus.text: Meaning, those who are hit by this flood disaster will get every help before they move back to their respective homes.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]
addressees: Datuk Seri Sh Mohmed Puzi bin Sh Ali [Pekan]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]
addressees: Datuk Seri Sh Mohmed Puzi bin Sh Ali [Pekan]

edus.text: Additional questions.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Verdon bin Bahanda [Kudat]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]
Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Mohd Nor]

edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Mohd Nor]

edus.speaker: Dato’ Verdon bin Bahanda [Kudat]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]

edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Please, Your Honor.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Thank you, Your Honor, for the opportunity and space given.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Siti Zailah binti Mohd Yusoff [Rantau Panjang]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Siti Zailah binti Mohd Yusoff [Rantau Panjang]
addressees: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah [Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi]

edus.text: I am interested in what the Honorable mentioned earlier

edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Tuan Che Alias bin Hamid asked the Minister of Natural Resources, Environment and Climate Change to state the extent of the ministry's commitment to amend the Water Services Industry Act 2006 [ Act 655 ]
edus.speaker: Tuan Che Alias bin Hamid [Kemaman]
addressees: Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: by imposing higher penalties and fines on water supply pollutants to deal with widespread water pollution, causing the frequency of water supply disruption.
edus.speaker: Tuan Che Alias bin Hamid [Kemaman]
addressees: Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: Thank you Honorable Kemaman,
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: thank you Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Mohd Nor]

edus.text: The Ministry of Natural Resources, Environment and Climate Change ( NRECC ) takes the water source pollution incident seriously.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: As a developing country, we are facing great challenges in ensuring sustainable and sustainable development.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: The disposal of domestic and dangerous waste into the river is some examples of water pollution actions faced and this matter needs to be dealt with proactively and holistically.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: For the information of Honorable Members, the ministry is implementing the process of amending the Water Services Industry Act 2006 [ Act 655 ] ,
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: involving three main matters aimed at increasing the period of punishment and the rate of fines on risky actions that cause pollution to any water grooves or water supply system.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: In this regard, the amendment involves an increase in fines from RM100 thousand to RM10 million,
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: while the prison sentence is increased from one year to 15 years or both.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: `` 1020 Second, involves listing new offenses such as any act that causes or may cause the closure of the water supply system or water supply disruption to users as well as releasing any sewage, efluen, material or material into any grooves.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: Third, allows water license holders and also consumers to reclaim costs to restore the water supply system that has been tainted from the guilty party.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: This involves section 121 and section 122 of Act 655.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: The amendment of this act is in the ministry's review and research stage
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: before being raised for the approval of the Attorney General's Department and the amendment is expected to be presented in the Parliament Meeting in June 2023.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: Next, we have to be aware that the Water Services Industry Act ( WASIA )
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: or Act 655
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: only if pollution occurs on water supply.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: At the same time, as we know the Environmental Quality Act 1974 ( AKAS ) is also in the process of amending before Parliament is dissolved
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: and we intend to continue the amendment
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: because this involves any pollution regardless of location or jurisdiction and involves the amendment of compound and penalty elements
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: and also to empower the act.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: I would also like to draw the attention of the Honorable Members and this honorable House that the ministry also implements several non-structural approaches or nature-based solutions to provide education and public awareness about the sustainability of the river
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: and ensure the quality of river water is guaranteed.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: This includes:
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: ( i ) national river trail development program;
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: ( ii ) River Water Day Celebration;
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: ( iii ) Environmental Friends; and so on.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: At the same time, we would also like to remind that the preventive measures of pollution incidents are not solely on the shoulders of the Federal Government.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: Water sources are under the jurisdiction of the state government and this involves zoning, involving surrounding areas and so on with the state government
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: and also local authorities, thank you.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: Thank you Honorable Minister for the answer that has been given.
edus.speaker: Tuan Che Alias bin Hamid [Kemaman]
addressees: Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: The issue of water pollution in the water treatment plant source is still at a worrying level
edus.speaker: Tuan Che Alias bin Hamid [Kemaman]
addressees: Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: and often happens in our country to the point of affecting the needs of the residents in our country.
edus.speaker: Tuan Che Alias bin Hamid [Kemaman]
addressees: Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: My additional question, apart from the amendment of the act by imposing heavier penalties and fines on water supply pollutants,
edus.speaker: Tuan Che Alias bin Hamid [Kemaman]
addressees: Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: what proactive efforts should be done and implemented by the ministry in curbing this issue which is becoming more critical considering that those who do this pollution need to be fully responsible for the entire impact of the pollution done by these people.
edus.speaker: Tuan Che Alias bin Hamid [Kemaman]
addressees: Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: It includes cleaning the contaminated water source at the same time we hope they can compensate the affected residents.
edus.speaker: Tuan Che Alias bin Hamid [Kemaman]
addressees: Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: Please explain.
edus.speaker: Tuan Che Alias bin Hamid [Kemaman]
addressees: Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Tuan Che Alias bin Hamid [Kemaman]
addressees: Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: Therefore, as I have emphasized earlier in the amendment that we want to make to Act 655 which we want to bring to Parliament this year in June 2023, God willing.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: Among other things is to allow the water supply company and even the consumer to demand from the parties causing pollution.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: However, we also need to know that the element of water supply disruption is a large element,

266: Menteri Dalam Negeri [Datuk Seri Saifuddin Nasution bin Ismail] said, Therefore, there are some who have succeeded.

270: Menteri Dalam Negeri [Datuk Seri Saifuddin Nasution bin Ismail] said, There are people like this too.
271: Menteri Dalam Negeri [Datuk Seri Saifuddin Nasution bin Ismail] said, I have to honestly confirm in this Parliament.
272: Menteri Dalam Negeri [Datuk Seri Saifuddin Nasution bin Ismail] said, However, he does know the second category,

277: Menteri Dalam Negeri [Datuk Seri Saifuddin Nasution bin Ismail] said, I also want to mention the results of the police investigation so far, the viral video shows that there are individuals who are tortured and beaten not involving Malaysians so far.
278: Menteri Dalam Negeri [Datuk Seri Saifuddin Nasution bin Ismail] said, So through the profile we have made this as well, we find that among those we save and bring back,

284: Menteri Dalam Negeri [Datuk Seri Saifuddin Nasution bin Ismail] said, We bring them back too.

287: Menteri Dalam Negeri [Datuk Seri Saifuddin Nasution bin Ismail] said, The third is that Mr. President, we managed to bring it back,
288: Menteri Dalam Negeri [Datuk Seri Saifuddin Nasution bin Ismail] said, after that he left.
289: Menteri Dalam Negeri [Datuk Seri Saifuddin Nasution bin Ismail] said, There are people like this also.
290: Menteri Dalam Negeri [Datuk Seri Saifuddin Nasution bin Ismail] said, The police force were devastated when told that we detected they had gone again, and they contacted for help again.
291: Menteri Dalam Negeri [Datuk Seri Saifuddin Nasution bin Ismail] said, So, where is this from?

309: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu] said, We know that job scammer activities or other scams, especially those made online, are very related to cyber security which is still the main concern in our country.
310: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu] said, Many government and private organizations often experience cyber attacks through various viruses, malware, phishing and ransomware.
311: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu] said, I would like to ask the Honorable, especially the government and also the KDN that have cyber crime units,
312: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu] said, what are the strong and convincing cyber security measures that have been and will be taken by the government to overcome the invasion and theft of data which also leads to this job scammer activity.

314: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu] said, Thank you.
